resources.string: Pick one of your pits: its seeds are sown one by one into the next pits, going counterclockwise. Capture seeds as the rules allow. Whoever ends with more seeds wins.
6 pits with 4 seeds each and a store. A last seed in your store gives another turn; in an empty pit of yours, it takes the seeds opposite.
The stores are not sown. Make 2 or 3 seeds in the computer’s pits to take them, and never leave it without seeds.
Your turn: tap one of your pits (bottom row)
Your last seed fell in your store: play again!
The computer has no seeds: pick a pit that gives it some
